title: Confidential Letter Dated January 14, 1933 Addressed To Shanghai Municipal Police Re Communist Publications

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Special Branch S.2.
REPORT
File No. 4419
Date January 31, 1933.

Subject (in full) Confidential letter dated January 14, 1933 addressed to
Shanghai Municipal Police re communist publications.

Made by D.I. Kuh Pao-hwa. Forwarded by [签名]

With reference to the attached confidential letter No.8,
character Tseng (政), dated January 14, 1933, addressed to
the Shanghai Municipal Police from General Wen Hung En, Chief of
the Shanghai Public Safety Bureau, on the subject of two
communist publications from Hopei Province entitled the "Hopei
Anti-Imperialist News" and the "Hopei anti-Imperialist Youth,"
I have to state that discreet enquiries have been made by
C.D.S. 155 with a view to tracing any editorial offices or
sales agencies of these publications in Shanghai but without
result. Copies of these publications have not been found in
any of the recent communist bases raided nor are copies to
be purchased from any local bookstore or newspaper vendor.
The Chinese staff of this office have been instructed
to take note of the aforementioned publications.

（批：ccp）
Kuh Pao-hwa
D. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

（批：Reg. Please acknowledge formally. [签名] 2/2 '33）
page_data.zh:
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
特务科 S.2.
报告
档案号 4419
日期 1933年1月31日。

事由（全称） 关于共产主义出版物的1933年1月14日密函，致上海公共租界工部局警务处。

由督察顾宝华（Kuh Pao-hwa）呈报。转呈人 [签名]

兹提及附件中编号为第8号、代字“政”、日期为1933年1月14日、由上海市公安局局长温鸿恩（Wen Hung En）将军致上海公共租界工部局警务处的密函，内容涉及两份来自河北省的共产主义出版物，题为《河北反帝新闻》和《河北反帝青年》。本人谨此陈述，刑事侦缉处第155号探员已进行谨慎查访，试图追踪上述出版物在上海的任何编辑部或销售代理机构，但未有结果。在近期被突袭的共产主义据点中未发现这些出版物的副本，也无法从任何本地书店或报贩处购得。本办事处华籍职员已奉命对上述出版物予以留意。

（批注：中共）
顾宝华
督察

特务科主管警官。

（批注：登记。请正式回复收悉。[签名] 1933年2月2日）

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL
& S. B. REGISTRY.
D 4419
Translation of a confidential letter No. 8, character
Tseng(曾), dated January 14, 1933, addressed to the
Shanghai Municipal Police, from General Wen Hung-sheng(文鴻生),
Chief of the Shanghai Public Safety Bureau.

We have received confidential order No. 484 from
the Municipality of Greater Shanghai which reads as follows:-
"We have received from the Executive Committee of
the Shanghai Special District Kuomintang confidential
letter No. 576, character Tsuh(褚) which refers to
confidential letter No. 3951 from the Propaganda
Department of the Central Kuomintang Headquarters to
the effect that the 'Hopei Anti-Imperialist News
(河北反帝新聞)', published by the Hopei Anti-Imperialist
News Agency, and the 'Hopei Anti-Imperialist
Youth(河北反帝青年)', purporting to be published by the
Youth Department of the Anti-Imperialist League of Hopei,
are communist publications which should be suppressed.
Apart from requesting postal censors to detain the
above mentioned communist publications, the Propaganda
Department of the Central Kuomintang Headquarters also
request this Municipality to instruct subordinate
organs to take necessary action. Instructions have
therefore been given to all those concerned and the
Public Safety Bureau is hereby instructed to act
accordingly and submit a report."
Upon the receipt of the above confidential order
from the Municipality of Greater Shanghai, we have instructed
our men to suppress and detain the communist publications
in question and request your department to take due to take
necessary action.
page_data.zh:
上海公共租界
& 特务科登记处。
D 4419
1933年1月14日上海市公安局局长温鸿生（Wen Hung-sheng）致上海公共租界工部局警务处的第8号密函（代字“曾”）译文。

我方收到大上海市政府第484号密令，内容如下：-
“我方收到上海特别区国民党执行委员会第576号密函（代字‘褚’），该函提及国民党中央党部宣传部第3951号密函，指出由河北反帝新闻社出版的《河北反帝新闻》，以及声称由河北反帝同盟青年部出版的《河北反帝青年》，均为应予查禁的共产主义出版物。除要求邮政检查员扣留上述共产主义出版物外，国民党中央党部宣传部亦请本市政府指令下属机构采取必要行动。因此已向所有相关方下达指令，并特此指令公安局依此办理并提交报告。”
在收到上述大上海市政府密令后，我方已指令所属人员查禁并扣留有关共产主义出版物，并请贵部门采取相应必要行动。
